{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
filtered_df = df[~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask]
num_remaining = len(filtered_df)
print(f'Number of remaining rows: {num_remaining}')

# Convert revenue to float
filtered_df['revenue'] = filtered_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rates within each customer_segment
segment_channel_conv = filtered_df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f'Conversion rate by segment and channel:\n{segment_channel_conv}')

# Compute difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment
diff_by_segment = segment_channel_conv['email'] - segment_channel_conv['paid_search']
print(f'Difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) by segment:\n{diff_by_segment}')

# Compute segment sizes
segment_sizes = filtered_df.groupby('customer_segment').size()
print(f'Segment sizes:\n{segment_sizes}')

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment * segment_sizes).sum() / segment_sizes.sum()
print(f'Weighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff:.6f}')"}
